purpose: maintainer review 2026-11-01, section 6: provider capacity, storage price and datacenter stock for the hybrid full search's ~300 GB network volume on one L40S. READ-ONLY queries; nothing was created, started, resized or deleted.

account.note: currentSpendPerHr 0.005 = the 55 GB volume (55 x 0.07 / 720 = 0.00535); spendLimit 80 is an ACCOUNT spend limit at the provider, below every proposed full-experiment total

pods.note: no pod exists, running or exited

network_volumes.command: runpodctl network-volume list; GraphQL myself { networkVolumes { id name size dataCenterId } }

l40s_price.command: GraphQL gpuTypes(input:{id:"NVIDIA L40S"}) { securePrice communityPrice lowestPrice(input:{gpuCount:1, secureCloud:true}) { uninterruptablePrice stockStatus } } (UA aadistill-watchdog/1.0, src/aadistill/infrastructure/provider.py)
l40s_price.note: pod create provisions SECURE cloud (network volumes are Secure-Cloud only), so the rate is securePrice 1.09, unchanged from the plan; communityPrice is not a price this project can be billed at

l40s_by_datacenter.command: runpodctl datacenter list (stockStatus) + GraphQL lowestPrice(input:{gpuCount:1, secureCloud:true, dataCenterId:<dc>}) + GraphQL dataCenters { id storageSupport }
l40s_by_datacenter.note: the CLI lists 8 datacenters with L40S; the GraphQL per-datacenter secure quote returns 1.09/h 'Low' in six and nothing in US-MO-1 and US-NC-1. The two sources disagree for EUR-IS-2, EU-NL-1, US-MO-1 and US-NC-1 (CLI stockStatus empty); 'Low' is the provider's only stock grade seen here and gives no GPU count (maxUnreservedGpuCount null). storageSupport is false in EUR-IS-2 (am5m373kuq's datacenter), OC-AU-1, US-MO-1 and US-TX-4.

network_volume_price.command: WebFetch https://docs.runpod.io/storage/network-volumes; runpodctl billing network-volume (last 4 day rows)
network_volume_price.note: storage is a dated stated constant (memory gpu-price-is-not-the-bill): the docs' 0.07/GB/month, confirmed by the bill's own rows at 0.07/720 per GB-hour. The provider's volume rows have billed more GB-hours than a volume can hold (1,540 GB-h on a 55 GB volume in one UTC day = 28 h): the conservative column scales by 1540/1320. Container disk is billed separately at 0.10/GB/month for the pod's lifetime.

value.how: runpodctl network-volume update <id> --size <GB> (must be larger than current)
value.docs: Volume size can be increased later but cannot be decreased
value.am5m373kuq_caveat: EUR-IS-2 reports storageSupport false now; whether a resize is accepted there is unknown and was NOT tried (a resize is a mutation)

measured_repo.what: persist_unit copy of one trained 596M checkpoint to /runpod-volume plus re-identification from the landed bytes

write_throughput.note: one repo measurement (H1 P1g, 2026-10-23, an A100 pod's volume); the search's per-expansion persistence of a 1.19 GB bf16 state is ~9 s copy+verify at that rate

conclusion.rate_basis: L40S securePrice 1.09 USD/h (quoted 2026-11-01T10:21:50Z, unchanged) + container disk 0.10/GB/month for the pod's provisioned disk + network volume 0.07/GB/month on a 720 h month

datacenter.recommended: EU-NL-1 or US-TX-3 (both: storageSupport true AND an L40S secure quote at 1.09/h, stock Low; US-IL-1 likewise); the volume is created only in the datacenter whose L40S stock is confirmed at authorization time
datacenter.am5m373kuq: EUR-IS-2 has L40S quotes but storageSupport false: a NEW volume cannot be assumed there, and a resize of am5m373kuq to 300 GB is supported by the CLI but untested in a datacenter refusing new storage. The search reads no byte on am5m373kuq (its inputs are dev-box built), so a new volume elsewhere loses nothing; am5m373kuq stays as the supplement's archive
datacenter.rule: memory choose-gpu-before-the-volume: the volume's datacenter locks the GPU for the search AND for the six trainings that resume from it

risks: L40S stock is 'Low' everywhere it is offered and the API gives no GPU count: availability can vanish between the audit and the create (a no-cost create window with retries, as the runners already do)
the provider's 'Low' and the CLI's empty stockStatus disagree for four datacenters; the create call is the only definitive test
the account balance is 79.23 USD and the provider spend limit is 80 USD: below any full-experiment total, independent of the project caps
volume billing rows have exceeded size x 24 h per day (+17%)
a network volume serves one running pod at a time
